## Capture everything. Miss nothing.

Capture barcodes, IDs, and label data with vision AI that improves real-world accuracy and turns each scan into insight you can act on.

![](https://assets.scandit.com/40x40/a243422801/icon-product-barcode-scan-capture-blue.svg)Scan barcodes

Barcode scanning proven at 80bn scans a year. Low light, damage, distance, glare, plus differentiators like AR guidance and intent detection.

[Explore Barcode Scanning](https://www.scandit.com/products/barcode-scanning/)

![](https://assets.scandit.com/120x120/8ae8bc1abc/icon-label-scanning-blue.svg)Scan labels

Capture all barcode and text data from any label simultaneously, no manual entry required.

[Explore Label Scanning](https://www.scandit.com/products/smart-label-capture/)

![](https://assets.scandit.com/40x40/c259448a27/icon-products-id-scanning-validation.svg)Verify identity

Fast, accurate, and secure ID scanning and validation, processed on-device for maximum privacy. ISO 27001 Certified.

[Explore ID Scanning](https://www.scandit.com/products/id-scanning/)

![](https://assets.scandit.com/40x40/ebf1f0df10/icon-products-scandit-express.svg)Scandit Express turnkey app

Add barcode, text, or ID scanning to any iOS or Android app in less than 5 minutes, no custom development needed.

[Explore Scandit Express](https://www.scandit.com/products/scandit-express/)

## Get working code in minutes with Scandit Agent Skills

Scandit Agent Skills bring 15 years of barcode, label, and ID scanning expertise into your coding agent. Custom integrations and pre-built components both available.

[![Apple icon](https://assets.scandit.com/24x19/2baa2e8462/icon-apple.svg)iOS](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=ios) [![Android icon](https://assets.scandit.com/24x24/b4b953230f/icon-android.svg)Android](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=android) [![javascript](https://assets.scandit.com/16x16/9e71c9cb0e/icon-javascript.svg)JavaScript](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=web) [![React Native](https://assets.scandit.com/18x16/93b5867a13/icon-react.svg)React Native](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=react) [![](https://assets.scandit.com/17x16/b6498d096b/icon-cordova.svg)Cordova](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=cordova) [![kotlin multiplatform](https://assets.scandit.com/24x24/6e2bb50d4a/icon-kotlin.svg)Kotlin Multiplatform](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=kmp) [![](https://assets.scandit.com/13x16/63299a1211/icon-flutter.svg)Flutter](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=flutter) [![](https://assets.scandit.com/43x16/1f7fa214cd/icon-dotnet.svg).NET](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=net) [![](https://assets.scandit.com/17x16/a18abab195/icon-capacitor.svg)Capacitor](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=capacitor) [![icon titanium](https://assets.scandit.com/16x16/0afeb54eec/icon-titanium.svg)Titanium](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=titanium) [![icon tux](https://assets.scandit.com/14x16/b1ff0cd0f4/icon-tux.svg)Linux](https://docs.scandit.com/?framework=linux)

```
# Install with one command:
npx plugins add scandit/skills

# Claude Code:
## 1.
/plugin marketplace add scandit/skills
## 2.
/plugin install scandit-sdk@scandit-plugins

# Codex CLI:
## 1.
codex plugin marketplace add scandit/skills
## 2.
codex plugin add scandit-sdk@scandit-plugins
```
